title: The night that lasted nine hours
hints: Only shifts across a DST change are wrong. For the reproduction, print `shift.start.utcoffset()` and `shift.end.utcoffset()`. They differ, so is that difference reflected in `hours`?
`hours` subtracts two aware datetimes that share the same `tzinfo` object. In that case Python ignores the offsets and subtracts the wall-clock readings, so the extra (or missing) hour vanishes.
Convert both ends to UTC before subtracting: `(self.end.astimezone(UTC) - self.start.astimezone(UTC)) / timedelta(hours=1)`, with `UTC` imported from `datetime`.
